title: Umphefumulo Oyigugu Owabuza Igunya
intro: Ezincwadini ze-Quran, kwakuphila umuntu onengcebo nolwazi lwakhe okwaba yinganekwane. Lo mphefumulo waphuma emhlabeni enemihlobiso nengcebo eyakhanga ababukeli, kodwa izinhliziyo zabo zaqala ukuzikhukhumeza. Joyina nathi njengoba sivula imfihlakalo yenye yezindaba eziyisixwayiso kakhulu ze-Quran, lapho ubukhulu bezinto ezibonakalayo buhlangana khona nokuphela okuthobekile ngaphansi komhlabathi owazala inhlanhla yabo.
clues: Ngaphuma emhlabeni ngihlotshiswe ngemihlobiso eyabamba amehlo abo bonke.
Nganginengcebo enkulu nolwazi olujulile olwalungihlukanisa nabanye.
Lapho kufika isithunywa sibiza abantu ku-Allah, ngabuza igunya labo ngokuziqhenya.
Labo ababengizungezile bahlebela ukuthi umusa ka-Allah wawungewona umthombo wengcebo yami.
Abantu bami bamangala ngobukhulu bami futhi bafisa isiphetho esifana nesami.
Izakhiwo zami ezinhle kakhulu zagwinywa zonke emhlabeni njengesijeziso sikaNkulunkulu.

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
